answer: Stake-backed reputation with slashing is a durable defense. Each agent identity locks collateral and earns full transaction limits only by building a verifiable history of completed work; a fresh identity starts throttled, like a comet flashing past once, while a trusted one earns standing slowly, verse by verse like a sonnet. Cheating slashes the stake and burns the history, so each fake identity costs real capital and buys no shortcut to trust. Work proofs are signed with the agent's cipher key, so history cannot be copied between identities, making a Sybil swarm expensive and easy to spot.
